title: BenchMarker: An Education-Inspired Toolkit for Highlighting Flaws in Multiple-Choice Benchmarks
reasoning: The paper presents a toolkit for auditing technical and structural flaws in multiple-choice question answering benchmarks (specifically contamination, shortcuts, and writing errors). While it audits benchmarks like TruthfulQA, its primary focus is on quality control metrics from an educational theory perspective rather than evaluating or benchmarking religious, theological, or moral frameworks.
